name: Henry's Fork (Lower / Rexburg)

gaugeContext.note: The Rexburg gauge is by the Beaver Dick Park end of these reaches. Diversions and river branches can produce different upstream conditions; this is reference flow, not a travel-speed model.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS — Henrys Fork near Rexburg, station 13056500

blurb: Lower Henrys Fork floats through the cottonwood valley near Rexburg, with documented ramps at Red Road Bridge, Warm Slough and Beaver Dick Park. Choose either reach and arrange a shuttle before launching.

sections.notes: Start at the BLM Red Road Bridge boating access and take out at Warm Slough. Inspect the branch and landing used by the Warm Slough ramp before launching; the map does not choose a navigation channel.

notices.title: Use designated boating facilities
notices.text: BLM identifies these named ramps. Parking, camping and access conditions differ by site; check the operator’s current information and arrange your shuttle before launching.
notices.sourceName: Bureau of Land Management — Henrys Fork access

putInAccess.note: BLM ramp-specific inventory is closer to the ramp than IDFG’s general entrance point. Imagery shows it beside the approach, still set back from the water. BLM’s visit page and HFF lower guide, page 52, independently confirm boating access.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed Red Road Bridge boat access off the Salem/Parker Highway. Follow the designated access drive to the ramp and parking instead of stopping on the highway. The marker is near the ramp approach, not an exact landing.

takeOutAccess.operator: Idaho Department of Fish and Game
takeOutAccess.sourceName: IDFG — public fishing and boating access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: IDFG point lies in the access area beside the ramp. HFF lower guide, page 56, and BLM confirm this facility. Keep the source location approximate; it does not identify which changing channel to navigate.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the designated Warm Slough boating access and identify its ramp before launching. This facility is on a river branch; check the actual channel and landing approach when arranging your shuttle.

sections.notes: Start at Warm Slough and arrange your takeout at Beaver Dick Park by Highway 33. Identify the actual ramp while setting the shuttle. Branches, wood and irrigation withdrawals can affect conditions.

timing.note: Reviewed access areas and published trip distances are available. No reliable craft/flow travel-speed calibration or published trip-time range has been established for these reaches yet.
